Returns a random whole number from `from` to `to`, both included. With one argument the range is 1 up to that number. The same seed (see [SeedRnd](SeedRnd)) always gives the same sequence.

```blitzbasic
;run
SeedRnd 1234
dice = Rand(1, 6)
Print dice >= 1 And dice <= 6
Print Rand(5, 5)
```

```text
1
5
```
@param from  Lowest result, or the highest when `to` is left out.
@param to    Highest result. Defaults to 1.
@returns A random integer in the range.
